description: A test script for git-http-backend handling of CONTENT_LENGTH, including setup, environment configuration, and various test cases for HTTP request handling, compression, and error conditions.

methods.name: verify_http_result
methods.description: Checks the HTTP response status and error messages, ensuring correct handling of fatal errors and status codes.

methods.name: test_http_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables and invokes the Perl script to simulate HTTP requests with specific handler types and request bodies.

methods.name: ssize_b100dots
methods.description: Calculates a size_t value just over SSIZE_MAX based on the size of size_t, used for testing overflow conditions.
